integrity: Exact transfer and symbolic-polynomial proof; independent direct finite-word enumeration is corroborative, not an infinite-size proof. No external independent validation.
scientific_limitations: Periodic nearest-neighbour chains, at least three colours, length at least four, strict energy-decrease exchanges; all labelled populations summed; neutral swaps, fixed-population counts and kinetic sampling not determined. Novelty relative to unindexed literature not guaranteed.
title: Antiferromagnetic strict-exchange Potts blocking has lower entropy than ferromagnetic blocking at every alphabet size
